build_stl10_builder: build the STL10 image classification dataset builder using tfds.builder_cls('stl10')
create_stl10_dataset: create an STL10 dataset from the builder using as_dataset with train or test split
test_stl10_builder: test the STL10 builder by downloading and preparing data with download_and_prepare
review_stl10_info: review the STL10 dataset metadata including splits, features, and version via builder.info
summarize_stl10_lazy_import: summarize the LazyBuilderImport Stl10 class that lazily resolves to the tfds stl10 builder
